principle: Each stage consumes hashed PASS artifacts; no stage may infer a missing value, bypass a HOLD, or substitute experimental evidence for a computational quantity.

execution.bulk_source: compact PASS artifact from the exact registered bulk workflow run
execution.mode: automatic sequential and matrix GitHub Actions route

stages.name: clean_slab_convergence
required_checks: surface excess domination tolerance <= 1.0 meV per surface atom
selected layer, vacuum, and k-mesh dimensions recorded

stages.name: na_pseudopotential_validation
required_checks: unique Na UPF from pinned SSSP archive
mixed cutoffs are the componentwise Cu-Na maximum

stages.name: adsorption_site_screening
required_checks: same 4x4 cell, 0.0625 ML coverage, cutoffs, and electrostatics used
global minimum classifies as fourfold hollow

stages.name: endpoint_geometry_verification
required_checks: nearest-neighbor hollow endpoints are distinct and symmetry-equivalent

stages.name: path_and_image_convergence
required_checks: ordinary NEB runs use 5, 7, and 9 images
barrier spread meets the 0.005 eV rule
smallest dominating converged image count selected

stages.name: climbing_image_neb
required_checks: CI enabled only after stage 7 PASS

stages.name: saddle_verification
required_checks: minimum Na partial Hessian is positive
saddle Na partial Hessian has exactly one negative mode
unstable mode aligns with the registered path by >= 0.70
0.02 and 0.04 A finite-difference results agree within 20 percent
plus and minus downhill relaxations reach distinct endpoint basins

stages.name: barrier_coordinate_extraction
required_checks: electronic forward and reverse barriers reported
computed rates reported at 100, 150, 200, 250, and 300 K
unsupported ZPE, thermal, friction, and linewidth fields remain null

stages.name: computational_atlas_admission
required_checks: computed rows contain system, phase, coverage, temperature, barrier, uncertainty, rate, and method
experimental columns remain distinct and null
public experimental candidate remains HOLD until exact state-point qualification

stages.name: integration_readiness
required_checks: stages 1 through 11 pass schema, state, dependency, and hash validation
validator is rerun after its own stage-12 artifact is written

experimental_only_gaps: direct experimental diffusion-rate table at the exact registered coverage and temperatures if no qualified public numeric table exists
system-specific friction or linewidth not computed by this route
full substrate vibrational determinant beyond the registered Na-only partial Hessian
independent physical replication outside the computational workflow
